acquisition_method.evidence: The DIA MS/SWATH MS analysis generates a set of differentially expressed proteins with respect to AgNPs.
Identical liquid chromatography conditions were used for both data dependent (DDA) and data independent (DIA) acquisition.

alkylation_concentration.evidence: Protein alkylation was initiated by adding 20 μL of 300 mM iodoacetamide (Sigma-Aldrich, St. Louis, MO, USA) in 100 μL of Urea buffer and incubated in the darkness for 20 min at room temperature, followed by centrifugation at 17,000× g for 20 min.

cleavage_agent.evidence: After changing collection tubes, 100 μL of 50mM NH4HCO3 and 1.5 μL of 0.5 μg/μL trypsin solution in ddH2O (Promega, Madison, WI, USA), were added for the overnight digestion at 37 °C.

collision_energy.evidence: The collision energy was set to 30%, and the normalized collision energy type was selected.

fragmentation_method.evidence: The collision energy was set to 30%, and the normalized collision energy type was selected.

ionization_type.evidence: Nano-electrospray was used to ionize the peptides, followed by their introduction into the Orbitrap Exploris™ 480 mass spectrometer (Thermo Scientific, Waltham, MA, USA).

labeling.evidence: The label free data independent acquisition (DIA) quantitative proteomics method was employed to study the proteotype changes triggered by AgNPs.
